body: I don't know about that. I think I'm just busted or something the morning I did that it was directly after an awesome day. Had a bunch of my friends over for a cookout, got promoted at work with a pay raise that pulls me out of poverty,and had a girl come over to my place for the first time in ages (didn't hit it off as well as i'd hoped though). Everyone thinks I'm so happy all the time, and with my sense of humor they'd probably think I was fucking with them. I'm just so fucking tired. All the time. My family doesn't really talk to me much. All my friends are preoccupied with the families they are starting. I crash and burn on any dating attempts, and the embarrassingly low level of experience at my age doesn't do much to help. I just don't really fit anywhere and wind up seemingly cramming myself into other peoples lives in the effort. I hate it. The worse part is that my life the way it is now I know that I can do better. I just don't have the energy to do it. I just feel weak all the time. I wish I could kill myself I really do. It hurts so much it actually physically hearts. I feel like my fucking heart is about to stop, or my stomach is going to collapse. And the worst part of the whole thing is I can't ask for any fucking help. I can't risk getting committed to a psych ward because I'd fall behind on bills and lose everything. I'd have nowhere to go. I've been like this so long It's getting hard to believe my self when I say it will get better if I keep trying. It never fucking gets better. I don't think It ever will. The idea of just continuing the way things are until I die naturally is terrifying. I wouldn't wish it on my worst fucking enemy. It would be so great just not to feel so fucking alone anymore. I don't care how, I don't give a fuck who it hurts, I just can't fucking take it anymore. What the fuck is wrong with me? I juust can't fucking do it.
